collection.title: SEAT Tarraco 2018 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a SEAT Tarraco 2018 Onwards which requires a 25" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Tarraco which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
